title: Allo Maalem
sub: Laravel 12, PHP 8.2, MySQL 8.0, Tailwind CSS, Stripe API, Docker
text:
- Built role-based portals for clients and artisans with custom middleware and monthly quota enforcement.
- Implemented concurrency-safe proposal hiring workflow using database transactions to prevent price tampering.
- Integrated Stripe API for tiered subscriptions and automated artisan invoicing.

title: BrainScan AI
sub: Python 3.11, TensorFlow 2.17, Streamlit, Docker, OpenCV, Scikit-Learn
text:
- Developed a custom 3-block CNN classifying 4 brain MRI categories with 96.51% test accuracy on 7,023 scans.
- Implemented clinical safety triage enforcing a 70% confidence threshold to flag ambiguous cases for review.
- Containerized Streamlit interface and Jupyter research lab with multi-stage Docker Compose architecture.

title: DeliveryETA
sub: Python 3.12, Scikit-Learn, Streamlit, Pandas, NumPy, Docker
text:
- Engineered geospatial distance features via Haversine formula and kitchen prep duration with rollover correction.
- Trained and tuned Random Forest regressor achieving R² of 0.764 and MAE of 3.53 minutes using 5-fold CV.
- Deployed interactive Streamlit app with unified ColumnTransformer preprocessing to prevent data leakage.

title: Diabetes Risk MLOps
sub: Python, Scikit-Learn, FastAPI, Streamlit, MLflow, Apache Airflow, Docker
text:
- Built machine learning pipeline using KNN imputation, K-Means clustering, and Logistic Regression.
- Orchestrated automated model retraining with Apache Airflow and tracked experiments using MLflow Registry.
- Containerized FastAPI inference microservice with Pydantic validation and interactive Streamlit UI.

title: EasyColoc
sub: Laravel 12, PHP 8.2, Blade, Tailwind CSS, MariaDB, Docker
text:
- Implemented automated equal bill splitting and real-time bilateral debt tracking with 1-click settlement.
- Created a gamified roommate reputation score with transactional debt reallocation upon member departure.
- Built multi-tier RBAC system (Admin, Owner, Member) with secure cryptographic token email invitations.

title: NeuroScan-AI
sub: Python, TensorFlow, InceptionV3, YOLOv8s, FastAPI, Streamlit, MLflow, Airflow, Docker
text:
- Fine-tuned InceptionV3 on MRI scans reaching 96.3% test accuracy and trained YOLOv8s for tumor localization.
- Automated end-to-end data preparation, training, and evaluation pipelines via 8-task Apache Airflow DAG.
- Exposed dual REST APIs with FastAPI, tracked models in MLflow, and deployed user interface in Streamlit.

title: s-MeteoRisk
sub: Python 3.11, Apache Airflow, PostgreSQL 16, SQLAlchemy, Streamlit, Docker
text:
- Extracted Open-Meteo REST API forecasts and modeled data across Bronze, Silver, and Gold PostgreSQL schema.
- Designed composite risk index evaluating wind gust thresholds, rain probability, and temperature extremes.
- Orchestrated daily cron ETL workflows using Apache Airflow and visualized municipality risks in Streamlit.

title: SATAS Bus
sub: Laravel 12, PHP 8.2, MariaDB, Tailwind CSS, Alpine.js, Dompdf, Docker
text:
- Developed multi-hop transit search across 20 Moroccan cities with dynamic segment fare calculation.
- Enforced 50-passenger capacity limits and race-condition-safe seat allocation to prevent overbooking.
- Implemented automated server-side PDF e-ticket generation and self-service booking cancellation workflow.

title: Workspace Manager
text:
- Built client-side CRUD worker management with real-time input validation and LocalStorage persistence.
- Implemented room capacity constraints and role-based access filters to dynamically optimize room assignments.
- Designed an interactive visual floor plan displaying real-time occupancy and remaining room capacity.

title: WavePMS
sub: Laravel 12, PostgreSQL, stancl/tenancy, Filament 5, Livewire 3, Tailwind CSS, Docker
text:
- Architected multi-tenancy with PostgreSQL schema isolation via stancl/tenancy for client data separation.
- Developed 8 role-based dashboards with Filament and Livewire for front desk, instructors, and kitchen.
- Integrated magic-link guest portal with digital waiver signing and flight delay tracking via external APIs.

title: QuranPlatform
sub: Laravel 12, React 19, Vite 8, Tailwind CSS v4, SQLite/MySQL, Sanctum, Docker
text:
- Built decoupled Laravel 12 REST API with Sanctum auth and React 19 SPA styled with Tailwind CSS v4.
- Created interactive Hifz memorization tracker with 240-Thumon progress mandala and streak heatmaps.
- Implemented video tafsir library with YouTube oEmbed integration and back-office administrative moderation.

title: YouCode
sub: Laravel 12, React 19, Vite 8, Tailwind CSS v4, Dompdf, Docker
text:
- Developed drag-and-drop ATS recruitment Kanban pipeline with custom hiring stages and deadline tracking.
- Implemented interactive quiz and poll feed with real-time voting animations and instant explanations.
- Built career asset vault and public recruiter portfolio with server-side PDF resume generation via Dompdf.
